استأجرت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْجَرْتُ (istaʔjartu) /is.taʔ.d͡ʒar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# اِسْتَأْجَرْتَ (istaʔjarta) /is.taʔ.d͡ʒar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# اِسْتَأْجَرْتِ (istaʔjarti) /is.taʔ.d͡ʒar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# اِسْتَأْجَرَتْ (istaʔjarat)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
